sonnet.problem: The card asks 'How does James answer?' and treats 'Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds' as James's own reply. The BSB gives no quotation marks and does not say whether the objector or James speaks these words, so the card guesses a speaker the text leaves open.
sonnet.rule: When the text doesn't say who is speaking, he doesn't guess. He uses a plain lead-in, like "Then the psalm says…", and names a speaker only when the passage or its heading does.
